title: LensGo AI is now Lovino: what changed & alternatives
summary: LensGo AI now redirects to Lovino. See what changed, current pricing, account and privacy checks, and the best alternatives for each creative workflow.
body_markdown:
LensGo AI is now Lovino. The original[lensgo.ai](https://lensgo.ai/) domain redirects to[lovino.ai](https://lovino.ai/) , and the destination identifies itself as “formerly LensGo.” The current product is a multi-model image and video workspace for product visuals, UGC-style ads, AI influencers, and cinematic generation. Old LensGo tutorials and price tables may no longer describe the product you will reach today.


**Our verdict:** evaluate Lovino as a current product, not as the old LensGo style-transfer tool. It is worth testing if you want one credit balance across many image and video models. Compare alternatives if you need a broader editing and API workflow, a video-first production suite, real-time visual exploration, or final design templates.


*Checked September 12, 2026. This is a documentation-led status and product assessment. We verified the redirect, live product pages, published pricing, terms, and privacy policy. We did not run a controlled output benchmark, so we do not repeat third-party claims about quality, speed, or consistency as our own findings.*


Quick Answer


## LensGo AI status at a glance


- **Current name:** Lovino
- **Observed redirect:** \`lensgo.ai\` redirects to \`lovino.ai\`
- **Current focus:** Multi-model image and video generation, UGC ads, product shots, reusable AI characters, and workflow automation
- **Free plan:** $0, three daily credits, 12 models, watermarked outputs
- **Paid plans shown:** Creator at $19.99 per month and Studio at $39.99 per month; yearly billing advertises a 20% saving
- **Old account migration:** Not explained on the public pages we reviewed; confirm projects, credits, billing, and login state inside the redirected account before purchasing
- **Best reason to compare:** The current Lovino product differs materially from the older LensGo experience described by many ranking reviews

## What happened to LensGo AI?


The clearest current evidence is the redirect itself. Visiting LensGo's original \`.ai\` domain lands on Lovino, whose homepage says “formerly LensGo.” Lovino is operated by Foldox Limited, according to its current terms.


This is more than a visual rename. Older LensGo reviews emphasize video-to-video style transfer, model training, text-to-image, and short generative clips. Lovino's current homepage leads with product ads, product photography, AI influencers, multi-model image and video generation, and an agent called Iris that plans visual kits from a brief.


Some of the earlier creative DNA remains. Lovino still lists image and video generation, style transfer, image enhancement, and reusable characters. But searchers should expect different navigation, plans, model access, and product emphasis from a 2024 or 2025 LensGo tutorial.


## What Lovino offers now


### A multi-model studio


Lovino says its studio combines 50 image and video models under one credit system. The live catalog names models such as GPT Image 2, FLUX 1.1 Pro, Nano Banana Pro, Imagen 4, Seedream 4.5, Recraft V4, Grok Imagine, Seedance 2.0, Veo 3.1, and Hailuo 02.


Treat that list as a current catalog, not a promise that every model supports the same input, duration, resolution, audio, or commercial terms. Before committing, open the exact model and record its cost, settings, and output rules.


### Product and UGC ad workflows


The current site highlights product shots and creator-style product ads. These are packaged outcomes rather than a blank prompt box: upload a product image, choose or build a visual direction, and generate assets for social or ecommerce use.


This positioning is useful if your deliverable is an ad set. It is less decisive if you need a general video editor, detailed timeline control, automated API production, or a documented cost per shot across several models.


### Reusable characters


Lovino's “Lens ID” feature is designed to keep a character's face consistent across scenes, outfits, and poses, then animate that identity into short video. Its terms separately require consent for features involving facial images.


### An AI planning agent


Lovino describes Iris as an agent that turns a brief into shots, prompts, model choices, and a visual kit on the canvas. That may reduce setup time for campaign ideation. Judge it by whether the resulting shot plan is editable and whether each generated asset has clear model and credit attribution.


## Lovino pricing after the LensGo rebrand


The current[Lovino homepage](https://lovino.ai/) shows three plans:


- **Free:** $0, three credits per day, 12 models, watermarked outputs, and community support.
- **Creator:** $19.99 per month, 120 monthly credits, all 50 listed models, Studio and Flow access, no watermark, up to 4K resolution, and priority support.
- **Studio:** $39.99 per month, 500 monthly credits, up to 4K resolution, priority chat support, and an API described as private beta with access by request.


Lovino advertises 20% savings on yearly billing. Its terms say purchased credit packs do not expire, subscription credits roll over for up to three months, and remaining subscription credits are removed at the end of the paid period after cancellation. Recheck the[live pricing page](https://lovino.ai/pricing) before paying because prices, credit costs, model access, and beta availability can change.


The old LensGo plan names and credit tables should not drive a current purchase. Calculate cost with one defined job instead:


1. choose a specific model and workflow;
2. define the output duration, resolution, and aspect ratio;
3. record the displayed credits before generation;
4. include rerenders and upscales;
5. divide total spend by accepted assets, not attempted generations.


## Do old LensGo accounts, credits, and projects move to Lovino?


The public pages we reviewed do not provide a clear migration document for old LensGo accounts, projects, credits, subscriptions, or trained assets. Do not assume that a domain redirect proves every account object transferred.


Use this checklist before adding payment details:


- enter through \`lensgo.ai\` and confirm the final \`lovino.ai\` destination;
- use the normal login route rather than a link from an unsolicited message;
- verify whether your prior projects and custom assets appear;
- compare the current credit balance with your last receipt;
- check the merchant name and renewal price;
- contact current Lovino support if any balance or project is missing.


Avoid reusing an old password on unrelated domains that merely contain “LensGo” in their name. Search results currently include other domains using similar wording; the original LensGo \`.ai\` domain is the verified redirect reviewed here.


## Privacy, facial images, and commercial rights


Lovino's[Terms of Service](https://lovino.ai/terms) say users retain rights to use generated images and videos for personal and commercial purposes. Free outputs include a Lovino watermark, while paid users receive watermark-free content with full usage rights. Users may not present AI-generated images as photographs or human-created art without disclosure.


For face-based features, the terms require users to upload only their own selfie or the image of someone who gave explicit consent. The terms state that facial images can be sent to third-party AI providers including Replicate and Google for processing, and that original selfies are deleted from Lovino's servers within 24 hours.


The[privacy policy](https://lovino.ai/privacy) says prompts, generated media, settings, favorites, and collections are collected. It states that prompts, generated images, and selfies are not used to train AI models without consent. Generated images and videos are retained while an account is active; users can request deletion of an account, selfie, or specific generated image.


Commercial rights do not replace source rights. You still need permission for uploaded faces, product photography, logos, music, footage, and other third-party material. Confirm the selected underlying model's restrictions if a client or regulated workflow depends on them.


## How to compare Lovino with alternatives


### 1. Choose one output


Use a real deliverable: a six-second product shot, a vertical UGC ad, an image-to-video clip, or a reusable-character scene. Do not compare unrelated demos.


### 2. Lock the brief


Keep the prompt, source image, reference style, aspect ratio, duration, and target resolution the same. If a platform uses a different model, record that difference.


### 3. Score what you can observe


Review prompt adherence, identity consistency, temporal stability, product geometry, text rendering, editability, and the amount of cleanup required. A beautiful first frame is not enough for video.


### 4. Record the accepted-output cost


Count every generation, rerender, upscale, and export needed to reach a usable asset. Note watermark and commercial-use status.


### 5. Check the production handoff


Confirm where the output goes next. A creative studio should reduce work across generation, revision, resizing, editing, review, and automation—not simply offer a long model menu.


## Best LensGo/Lovino alternatives


### Magic Hour: generation, editing, and APIs


[Magic Hour](https://magichour.ai/) combines text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, face swap, lip sync, talking photos, image generation, image editing, and production APIs. It is the stronger starting point when one job moves through several media operations or must later be automated.


### Runway: video-first creative production


[Runway](https://runwayml.com/) belongs on the shortlist when generative video and video-production controls are central. Compare its current models and editor against Lovino using the same shot, then price the accepted clip rather than the plan alone. See our[Runway pricing guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/runway-ml-pricing) .


### Krea: rapid visual exploration


[Krea](https://www.krea.ai/) is useful when you want quick iteration across image and video generation, enhancement, and real-time visual exploration. It is a better comparison than a template editor when the question is how fast you can explore and refine a look.


### Canva: layout and brand delivery


[Canva](https://www.canva.com/) is the practical alternative when generation is only one step before templates, brand assets, presentations, posts, and team approval. It is less of a model-routing studio and more of a final design system.
